messages:
Alex: Quick ask — we need a short LinkedIn + X thread for the product launch on Tue 9/10. 3 posts (lead, benefit, CTA to webinar). Assets are in Drive: https://drive.google.com/launch-assets. Need copy variants, image crops, and HubSpot routing. @Nina @Josh please pick up.
Nina: Got it. I can draft two copy variants (short headline + benefits). Do we want a more technical angle or product-economics?
Alex: Product-economics for the main thread, technical follow-up as a reply. Keep the lead post punchy.
Josh: I will prep image crops. For LinkedIn single image we should use 1200x628, and for X go 1200x675. For carousel use 1080x1080. Uploading v1/v2 now.
Josh: Uploaded: drive/launch_img_v1_1200x628.png, drive/launch_img_v1_1080x1080_1.png, drive/launch_img_v2_1200x675.png — alt text included in filenames.
social-bot: Buffer shows open slot on Tue 2024-09-10 10:00 AM PT (Queue: 2 free). Use slot?
Alex: Yes 10:00 AM PT (1pm ET). Also: UTM for links -> add `?utm_source=social&utm_medium=x_linkedin&utm_campaign=sept_launch`. Nina, include in CTA links.
Nina: Copy drafts uploaded: https://drive.google.com/launch-copy (two files: short_variant.md, benefits_variant.md). Hashtags suggested: #LLM #Inference #DevTools #RedwoodInference.
Eli: For the CTA thread reply, link to the webinar landing page and add the HubSpot form. I can own the webinar reminder emails and the landing page copy. Landing URL: https://redwood.ai/launch-webinar-draft (will finalize today).
Alex: Routing: HubSpot form should create contact + tag `marketing-launch-sept` and route to `SDR-Marketing` queue. @Oliver can you enable that workflow?
Oliver: Confirmed. HubSpot workflow created: assign to SDR-Marketing when `lead_source` == social and lead_score >= 30. Others go into nurture list. I also added property `campaign=marketing-launch-sept`.
Nina: Small copy tweak request: swap "fast" -> "predictable" in the second sentence to emphasize reliability. I'll update both variants.
Josh: Quick note on images: for X threads we should include 2:1 aspect for the lead card to avoid cropping. I added `lead_card_2x1.png`.
Alex: Final checklist before scheduling: 1) finalize copy (Nina) 2) images uploaded & alt text (Josh) 3) UTM and landing link in CTAs (Nina/Eli) 4) HubSpot workflow live (Oliver) 5) Buffer slot set for Tue 10:00 AM PT and tagged in calendar (social-bot/Josh) 6) Monitor engagement + tag top leads in Slack `#inbound-marketing` within 24h. Can someone confirm they can push to Buffer by EOD today?
Josh: Will queue images + copy to Buffer by 6pm PT and tag calendar event.
Nina: I'll drop final copy in the doc and add suggested thread reply language for followups (webinar sign-up + benchmark CTA).
social-bot: Scheduled preview created in Buffer for Tue 2024-09-10T10:00:00-07:00. Preview link: https://buffer.app/preview/abc123
Alex: Awesome — thanks team. After publish let's watch impressions, CTR, and leads. If benchmark shows <1% CTR on first 6h, we switch to variant B (short headline). I'll post results in #marketing. :eyes: 
Eli: I'll make sure webinar tracking is ready and pass UTM data to analytics.
Oliver: HubSpot alerts will go to `#inbound-marketing` and email `sdr-team@redwood.ai`.
Nina: Done — final copy version is `benefits_variant_final.md` in the drive folder.
Alex: Perfect. Closing this thread — ping here once Buffer is queued and HubSpot live. :rocket:
